scope_summary: Implement administrator-created random, one-time, expiring, revocable, SHA-256-hashed invitations with persistent audit records.
Require an explicit valid IANA timezone during invitation redemption and before legacy users may write journal data.
Persist login and invitation redemption rate limits by IP and account, including concurrency-safe first-bucket creation.
Fail production startup for weak or default signing secrets.
Remove plaintext Broker, Market, and LLM secret columns and setting rows through forward migration a1b2c3d4e5f6.
Reject plaintext secret writes and resolve optional platform secrets only from environment configuration or encrypted IntegrationCredential rows.
Disable online IBKR Flex credential use while retaining the future local statement-file boundary.
Apply centralized URL, query, secret, metadata, exception, log, and audit redaction.
Restore the invite registration UI with explicit timezone selection while keeping open registration disabled.
